LBR.note: No count of people enrolled is stated.
The firm is to develop the system; who will operate it is not stated.
Services to be supported are listed as aims only; no register keyed on the number.

facts.fact: Liberia's National Identification Registry said procurement of an Austrian firm to develop a new national biometric ID system under a public-private partnership is complete and a concession agreement finalised, awaiting presidential approval and legislative ratification.
